<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1216348_claim_0.GetEmployeeInfoByNum</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GetEmployeeInfoByNum</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GetEmployeeInfoByNumber = Class.create();
GetEmployeeInfoByNumber.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getInfo: function() {
        var empNum = this.getParameter('sysparm_empnum');
        var result = {};

        var empGR = new GlideRecord('x_1216348_claim_0_employee_table');
        empGR.addQuery('sys_id', empNum);
        //empGR.addQuery('sys_id','a6b4ae0a83ee2e10d33033d6feaad3e0');
        empGR.query();
		gs.info('Get Employee details');

        if (empGR.next()) {
			gs.info('Inside if');
            result.full_name = empGR.getValue('full_name');
            result.email = empGR.getValue('email');
            gs.info('fetched details' + result.full_name + result.email);
        }

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    }

});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-07 07:45:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>d43bb4de83ea6e10d33033d6feaad3ab</sys_id><sys_mod_count>9</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GetEmployeeInfoByNum</sys_name><sys_package display_value="claim management system" source="x_1216348_claim_0">fe2c0d9d836a2a10d33033d6feaad36b</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="claim management system">fe2c0d9d836a2a10d33033d6feaad36b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_d43bb4de83ea6e10d33033d6feaad3ab</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-07 09:36:13</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
